allow: PowerShell($body = '{"token":"test123"}'; $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/auth/login" -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType "application/json" -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host "Status: $\($response.StatusCode\)"; Write-Host "Content: $\($response.Content\)")

PowerShell($body = '{"token":"test123"}'; try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/auth/login" -Method POST -Body $body -ContentType "application/json" -UseBasicParsing } catch { $response = $_.Exception.Response; $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader\($response.GetResponseStream\(\)\); $content = $reader.ReadToEnd\(\); Write-Host "Status: $\($response.StatusCode\)"; Write-Host "Content: $content" })
